summary: Defines a DHCP option that lets a client ask for an address on a particular subnet. This helps when a relay agent or server serves several subnets and the client wants to say which one it needs. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When you ask for a seat at a big hall with many sections, you can say which section you want. This lets a computer ask for a particular part of the network.

questions: how to request an address from a specific subnet
